title: Who can attend the Mahotsav, and are there any spiritual or physical preparations required before arriving?

segments.text: Target Audience & Inclusivity ​Open to Everyone: The Annual Mahotsav is open to all seekers, regardless of your prior experience or background in spiritual practice. First-time visitors and advanced practitioners alike are equally welcome. ​Bringing Guests & Loved Ones: Members of Ashaeiynn are warmly encouraged to bring their family members, children, or friends along—there are no restrictions on who you can invite to share in the experience. ​Important Visitor Policy: Non-members are always welcome, but they must be accompanied by an already enrolled Ashaeiynn member. For security and spiritual alignment, Ashaeiynn does not entertain individuals arriving alone if they are not currently enrolled members. ​Preparation Requirements ​No Pre-Requisites: There are no mandatory spiritual practices, fasting, or physical preparations required before your arrival. ​Come as You Are: All that is needed is an open mind, a receptive heart, and a willing spirit. Everything required for your journey and practice will be naturally guided by the mentors and volunteers once you arrive at Ashaeiynn.
